text: Aoife's second interview at the bank is Thursday at 10am. She sounded really nervous on the phone, so I should text her good luck Wednesday night.
Rohan and his wife picked up their new puppy on Saturday. A beagle called Pickle. He's already chewed through a phone charger.

Graham was made redundant last week after nineteen years at the depot. He's putting a brave face on it but I don't think he's sleeping. His wife says he's been up at 4am every day scrolling job sites. He's got a meeting with the union rep on Tuesday at 10 about his payout. Need to call him on Sunday afternoon and see how he's actually doing.
Ebony's cat Biscuit is having a lump removed on November 4th. She's worried sick about the anaesthetic because he's fourteen.
Dawit got the job! Starts at the council on 11/3. Must send him a proper congratulations card.
Pick up dog food and the flea treatment before Friday.
Eva and Bruno split up. She told me over coffee this morning. She's staying with her sister Astrid for a few weeks until she finds somewhere.

Shreya's dad passed away on Tuesday night. The funeral is October 29th at 2pm at the crematorium on Mill Lane. I'm driving Deepa there. Don't forget to order flowers by Monday. Shreya asked for white lilies if anything, and donations to the hospice instead of more wreaths. Her brother is doing the eulogy and is apparently dreading it.
Thomas has an interview with Network Rail next Wednesday morning. Second time applying for that role.
Note to self: Hadiza is vegan and can't stand mushrooms. Worth remembering for the dinner.
Anil said his dog Rex turns ten on May 14. They're doing a little party in the garden with sausages for him.
Abigail's leaving do was meant to be Friday at 7pm but it's been cancelled because half the team has flu.
Kieran's mum is in hospital again with her chest. He's going up to Leeds tomorrow morning on the 8:15 train.

Mateo applied for the head chef job at the hotel. Interview is the 12th at half 9, then a cook-off the following week if he gets through. He's surprisingly calm about it. His partner Eva is the nervous one, she keeps texting him recipes. He's planning a duck dish with a cherry sauce for the cook-off. I said I'd be a guinea pig on Sunday night.
Juan mentioned his girlfriend Tanvi is expecting in March. They haven't told her parents yet.
Astrid Olsen from the running club works as a vet nurse at the practice on Grove Road. Handy to know.
I'm taking the afternoon off on Thursday for my own interview at 2:30. Need to iron the blue shirt.

Arturo's grandmother died on Sunday. He flies out to Santiago for the funeral on June 3rd and will be gone about ten days. Remind me to message him once he's back. His sister Abigail is staying behind to look after the house and their mum, who isn't well enough to travel. He mentioned he'd lost his appetite completely.
Yusuf's rabbit went missing from the garden on Saturday. The kids are devastated. He's put posters up all round the estate.

Lunch with Anika. She's been applying for jobs for four months now and has had nothing back except rejections. She's starting to really doubt herself. She's got a phone screen with an agency on Monday at 11am, which is the first bite in ages. I should send her that article about interview prep and maybe offer to do a practice run with her on Sunday. Also she loves bouldering, so maybe take her to the wall one evening to get her mind off things.
How did Lorenzo's interview go on Tuesday? I completely forgot to ask. Text him tonight.
Santiago and Bethany are getting married on 7/19 next year. Venue is a barn in the Cotswolds.
Yosef said his boss is retiring at Christmas and he's thinking of applying for her job. Applications close December 1st.
Ignacio's cat Luna was put to sleep this morning. She was nineteen. He's in bits. I'll drop round tomorrow evening with something to eat.
Lachlan, or Lockie as everyone calls him, just started at the brewery as an assistant brewer. Loves it so far.
Asha's birthday is April 22nd. She's been dropping hints about wanting a proper pair of hiking boots.

Rang Uncle Graham. His dog Bramble had surgery on her hip yesterday and came through fine, but she has to be crated for six weeks. He's exhausted from sleeping on the kitchen floor next to her. Aunt Deepa is away visiting her sister until the 30th, so he's doing it all on his own. I could pop up on Saturday morning and give him a few hours off.
Need to book the car in for its MOT, sort the bins, and renew the passport before March.
Karan and Deepa's tenth wedding anniversary is August 9th. They're going to Lisbon for a long weekend.

Aoife didn't get the job in the end. She was gutted, they went with an internal candidate. Should take her out for a drink this week. She's already applied for two more roles, one at a charity and one in Galway, closing on November 8th. Her flatmate Ebony thinks she should take a break first, but Aoife isn't the type.
Ebony's brother Sam has a final-round interview at Google in Dublin next Monday at 9am. She says he's a nervous wreck.
Hadiza is training for the Great North Run and has a physio appointment Friday at 4pm for her knee.
Bruno's company is making cuts. He has a consultation meeting on 10/28 at 3pm and expects to be let go. Don't forget to check in with him that evening.
Thomas mentioned his daughter starts nursery on November 2nd. He and Abigail are dreading the drop-off.
Juan's puppy, a little cockapoo called Mabel, has her first vet jab on Saturday morning.
Dr Nguyen said my results should be back by Wednesday afternoon.

Tanvi broke up with her partner of six years. She sounded okay on the phone, but her mum told me she's barely eating. I must ring her this weekend, and maybe ask Aoife to pop in too since she lives round the corner.

Long chat with Rohan at the school gate. His father-in-law died last month and his wife is still really struggling with it. The memorial is on December 6th at 11am in the church in Harrow, and they've asked people to bring a photo or a story. Rohan also mentioned he's been passed over for promotion again and is quietly looking at other jobs, though he'd only move for something in the city. Their puppy Pickle has been a good distraction for the kids at least.
Dawit loves jazz. Goes to Ronnie Scott's most months.
Shreya has an interview for the PhD place at Edinburgh on January 15 at 2pm, over Zoom. She's applied twice before.
Anders and his partner are moving to Bristol at the end of the month. Their leaving drinks are next Friday at 6.
Eva's dog Toffee has diabetes now and needs injections twice a day. She's finding it a lot on top of work.
Mrs Murphy next door lost her husband in the summer. Her son Kieran is visiting from Cork on the 21st.
Remember to send Arturo the link to that job posting at the studio. Closing date is Friday at noon.
Lorenzo got the job at the architecture firm. Starts Monday, 9am sharp. He's buzzing.
Groceries, then the vet at 5:40 for Milo's booster. Don't be late again.
Bethany Chen's new kitten arrived yesterday. Grey tabby, named Pepper. She's sending photos every hour.
Mateo's interview was rescheduled from the 12th to Tuesday the 17th at 10:30. Cook-off is still 10/24.
Asha's mum has a hospital appointment on 11/14 for her scan results. Asha is scared stiff. Offer to drive them both.
Yosef's brother Ari passed his driving test on the first go yesterday.
Karan says his team at the bank is being restructured. He's not sure if his role will survive. Ask him on Friday what HR told him.
Ignacio is applying to be a firefighter. Fitness test is the morning of March 3rd, and he's training five days a week.
Quiet day. Walked along the canal and finished the book.
Anika's grandad's funeral was on Thursday. Need to check how she's doing, it's been a rough few weeks for her with the job search too.
Kieran and Hadiza have booked a week in Crete in June. Their first holiday since the baby.
Abigail works nights at the children's hospital and is allergic to nuts.

Graham's 60th birthday is on February 2nd. His wife is throwing a surprise party at the cricket club that Saturday evening at 7. Must chip in for the present, she said a decent watch would go down well.
Anil's interview at the hospital went really well apparently. They said they'd let him know by Friday. Remind me to ask him on Saturday.
Santiago's parrot Kiwi is twenty today. He's having a cake made for the bird, no joke.

Astrid had her redundancy confirmed this afternoon. Last day is December 18th. She was oddly relieved, says she'd hated it for years. Her husband Lachlan is less calm about the mortgage. I'm meeting her for lunch on Wednesday at 1 anyway, so I'll bring the details of the recruiter Deepa used.
